LANCOOL III
Mid-tower modular chassis for all kinds of configurations
Equipped with 4 × 140 PWM fans (ARGB or non-RGB)
Featured airflow optimized mesh structure and hinged side panels
Supports up to 420 radiator or 3 x 360 radiators and a maximum of 10 fans
Offers 12 storage drives mounting locations
Upgraded cable management solution for a clean build
Categories: PC Cases, Lancool Series
Tags: airflow PC case, aluminum, best case, chassis, computer case, E-ATX, gaming case, Lianli, medium cases, Mid Tower, PC build, PC modding, PWM fan, RGB, tempered glass, water cooling
Description
LANCOOL III, the premium mid-tower chassis, offers better thermal performance than LANCOOL II by including 4 pre-installed 140mm PWM fans, and featuring fine mesh panels designed to ensure ample airflow is delivered to the high-end components while the system runs at peak performance.
Included
4 × 140mm PWM fan
Fully Mesh Design
Hinged Flip Panels
Unprecedented
Modularity
Optimize Cooling
Support
12 Drive Capacity
Cable Management
with Ease
Reversible FIO
AVAILABLE IN– TWO COLORS, TWO MODELSThe LANCOOL III black features a premium hairline brushed aluminum element that looks as good as it feels, while the LANCOOL III white features a minimalist white powder coating. The tempered glass panel allows showing off the internal components.
LANCOOL III
Black
White
Comes equipped with 4 x 140mm high airflow PWM fans that provide strong out-of-box cooling performance.
Front Intake Fan –200~1800 RPM / 83.5 CFM /2.3 mm H2O
Rear Exhaust Fan200~1800 RPM / 83.5 CFM / 2.3 mm H2O
LANCOOL III RGB
Black
White
Comes equipped with 3x 140mm ARGB PWM fans that have similar performance as the LANCOOL III RGB 140mm back PWM Fan.
Front Intake ARGB Fan300~1650 RPM / 83.5 CFM / 2.3 mm H2O
Rear Exhaust Fan200~1800 RPM / 83.5 CFM / 2.3 mm H2O
Offering 7 colors and 8 lighting modes (the 8th mode is MB SYNC), the included ARGB controller can be operated via the front IO C and M buttons and can extend its control for 3 additional ARGB devices.
EXTREME AIRFLOW CRAFTMANSHIPA fine mesh design has been implemented at the front, top, and both bottom side panels of the LANCOOL III.
Top and 2x Bottom Side Panels
The two bottom side panels provide sufficient airflow to efficiently cool the GPU when fans are installed above the PSU shroud
Front Panel
The 51% porosity offers an ample direct fresh air intake
HINGED PANELS ALL AROUNDThe hinged tempered glass side panels offer an unobstructed view of the interior configuration, while the bottom shroud panels provide quick access to the PSU and storage drives.
The two removable 4mm tempered glass panels located on each side of the case can be opened by pulling the front aluminum handle.
The mesh panels located on both sides of the PSU shroud area can be removed for cleaning when the front panel is unattached.
FLEXIBLE CONFIGURATIONWith ample interior room, the LANCOOL III can offer different cooling and usage scenarios
AIR CoolingWith high airflow stock fans, and air tower clearance up to 185mm, the LANCOOL III is ideal for an air-cooling build.
AIO CoolingWith ample front intake, the LANCOOL III can provide strong performance for an AIO cooling build. The top fan bracket can support up to 3 x 120mm/140mm fans and offers enough thickness clearance for an AIO with a 420 radiator/fan combo.
Custom Water CoolingWith the ability to support 3 × 360mm radiators simultaneously, the LANCOOL III can offer custom water-cooling enthusiasts, lots of imagination.
SPACIOUS COOLING SUPPORTThe LANCOOL III is optimized for water-cooling and high-end thermal solutions. A maximum of 10 × 120mm fans or a large 420mm radiator can be mounted in the main chamber.

Modular PSU Shroud Bracket – Fan/ Pump/ SSDThe adjustable modular PSU shroud bracket can accommodate 1 x 360mm radiator, 3 x 120mm fans, 3 x 2.5” SSDs, or a pump/reservoir combos.
Back-and-forth adjustability to accommodate for different 360 radiator orientations.Note: When mounting a radiator or fans, make sure the plates are removed for better cooling potential.
Included mounting points for 3 × 2.5” SSDs.
Additional pump/reservoir combos mounting points are provided.
Side Multi-Purpose Mounting SlotsMounting slots beside the motherboard are provided at 105mm apart (standard 120mm fan mounting points) to allow the installation of a distro plate or a reservoir/pump bracket.
EXTENSIVE STORAGE CAPACITYMultiple storage drive mounting locations are supported for up to 12 x 2.5” SSDs or 4 x 3.5” HDDs and 8 x 2.5” SSDs.
❶Adjustable Drive Cage2 adjustable drive cages (each for 2 x 3.5” HDDs or 2 x 2.5” SSDs) can be individually removed or adjusted.
❷Toolless SSD tray Two spring-loaded SDD trays located behind the motherboard tray allow for a toolless installation of the drives.
❸Side SSD trayThe side-mounted SSD trays located inside the right PSU shroud panel can support up to 3 x 2.5” SSDs or can be removed to improve airflow.

COMPREHENSIVE CABLE MANAGEMENTAs the second chamber located on the right side is visible, great consideration has been given to cable management. The LANCOOL III features an upgraded solution to ensure neat cable routing with toolless magnetic cable cover doors, and a well-organized layout for hubs and cables.

FRIENDLY PSU INSTALLATIONThe removable PSU mounting bracket allows for PSU installation outside of the chassis, to then slide it in through from the rear.
ANTI-SAG BRACKET FOR PERFECTLY HORIZONTAL GPUA GPU anti-sag bracket is included for a seamless display of the hardware through the side tempered glass panels.
